rule: If lib-dms is not worse than fedavg on benign flows harmed (cluster Wilcoxon, Holm p >= 0.05, or mean difference < 0.5 points), federation is not necessary given a public attack library: re-scope the paper to the mitigation policy with federation as an optional deployment. lib-all is reported as an upper bound for libraries but is not part of the decision, because it assumes generators for every attack variant are public.
